description: Parking Regulation Locations and Signs is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. Department of Transpiration manages approximately 1,000,000 signs on the streets of New York. This dataset contains current and historical parking regulation signs. For all street signs, please use Street Sign Work Orders. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are parking, regulation, status, sign, sims. The table has 25 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Transportation (DOT). The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
